# smplOS keybinding snapshot: every bind the stock config registers, as bindings_loader.lua
# translates it for Hyprland. Regenerate with: tools/keybind-check snapshot --update
# Columns: source | chord | description | text in the bind file -> hl.bind() action {options}
# A "policy on" line shows what a workspace-policy session gets where it differs.
stock | SUPER+RETURN | Terminal | exec terminal -> exec_cmd("terminal")
stock | SUPER+SPACE | Start Menu | exec toggle-start-menu -> exec_cmd("toggle-start-menu")
stock | SUPER+SUPER_L |  | exec toggle-start-menu -> exec_cmd("toggle-start-menu") {"ignore_mods":true,"release":true}
stock | CTRL+ALT+SPACE | Start Menu (VM) | exec toggle-start-menu -> exec_cmd("toggle-start-menu")
stock | SUPER+A | App Center | exec toggle-app-center -> exec_cmd("toggle-app-center")
stock | SUPER+SHIFT+F | File manager | exec focus-or-launch --current-workspace nemo nemo -> exec_cmd("focus-or-launch --current-workspace nemo nemo")
stock | SUPER+ALT+SHIFT+F | File manager (floating) | exec nemo --class nemo-float -> exec_cmd("nemo --class nemo-float")
stock | SUPER+SHIFT+B | Web browser | exec focus-web-browser -> exec_cmd("focus-web-browser")

stock | CTRL+SHIFT+Escape | Task Manager (btop) | exec terminal -e btop -> exec_cmd("terminal -e btop")
stock | SUPER+W | Close window | killactive -> window.close()
stock | SUPER+SHIFT+R | Rescue all windows to this workspace | exec rescue-windows -> exec_cmd("rescue-windows")
stock | SUPER+P | Pseudo window | pseudo -> window.pseudo()
stock | SUPER+T | Toggle window floating/tiling | togglefloating -> window.float({"action":"toggle"})
stock | SUPER+SHIFT+P | Pin window (sticky across workspaces) | exec hyprctl dispatch "hl.dsp.window.float({action='toggle'})" && hyprctl dispatch "hl.dsp.window.pin()" -> exec_cmd("hyprctl dispatch \"hl.dsp.window.float({action='toggle'})\" && hyprctl dispatch \"hl.dsp.window.pin()\"")
stock | SUPER+F | Full screen | fullscreen 0 -> window.fullscreen({"mode":"fullscreen"})

stock | SUPER+ALT+F | Full width | fullscreen 1 -> window.fullscreen({"mode":"maximized"})

stock | SUPER+DOWN | Move focus down | movefocus d -> focus({"direction":"down"})

stock | SUPER+bracketleft | Scroll to previous column | layoutmsg move -col -> layout("move -col")
stock | SUPER+backslash | Center focused column in view | layoutmsg center -> layout("center")

stock | SUPER+SHIFT+bracketleft | Pan view left | layoutmsg move +400 -> layout("move +400") {"repeating":true}

stock | SUPER+CTRL+SHIFT+RIGHT | Move column right | layoutmsg swapcol r -> layout("swapcol r")

stock | SUPER+CTRL+R | Resize mode (arrow keys to resize - Esc to exit) | submap resize -> submap("resize")
stock | resize: LEFT | Shrink window width | resizeactive -20 0 -> window.resize({"relative":true,"x":-20,"y":0}) {"repeating":true}
stock | resize: RIGHT | Expand window width | resizeactive 20 0 -> window.resize({"relative":true,"x":20,"y":0}) {"repeating":true}
stock | resize: UP | Shrink window height | resizeactive 0 -20 -> window.resize({"relative":true,"x":0,"y":-20}) {"repeating":true}
stock | resize: DOWN | Expand window height | resizeactive 0 20 -> window.resize({"relative":true,"x":0,"y":20}) {"repeating":true}
stock | resize: ESCAPE | Exit resize mode | submap reset -> submap("reset")
stock | resize: RETURN | Exit resize mode | submap reset -> submap("reset")
